description: This file defines the MessageControl class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class declarations, nested classes, interfaces, and method signatures related to message control, WebSocket communication, plugin management, and remote connection notifications. The file sets up the structure for message handling, configuration, and observer pattern implementation for remote connections.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class implementing message control functionalities, including configuration, observer management, message dispatching, and remote connection notifications.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: A thread class used internally by MessageControl to run the dispatch loop.

classes.name: ICollect
classes.description: Interface for message collection and callback handling.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class for MessageControl settings.

classes.name: NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents a network node with NodeId, Port, and Binding.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications, manages attach/detach states, and dispatches connection events.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and forwards them to interested parties.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel to the message control.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel from the message control.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements or messages.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or gets the callback for message collection.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message types for specific categories and modules.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Provides an iterator over message control settings.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches messages from the message client to handlers.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of temporary or obsolete files.
